#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    long long sl[51];
    sl[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 50; ++i) {
        sl[i] = sl[i-1] + (1LL << i);
    }

    int h;
    long long n;
    std::cin >> h >> n;

    n += sl[h-1];

    std::vector<long long> nl;
    long long tn = n;
    nl.push_back(tn);
    while (tn != 1) {
        tn = tn / 2;
        nl.push_back(tn);
    }

    long long ans = 0;
    long long cn = 1;
    bool cp = false;

    while (cn != n) {
        std::vector<long long> tnl;
        for (int i = 0; i < h; ++i) {
            tnl.push_back(cn);
            if (cp == false) {
                cn = cn * 2;
            } else {
                cn = cn * 2 + 1;
            }
            cp = !cp;
        }
        if (cn == n) {
            ans += h;
            break;
        }
        tnl.push_back(cn);
        std::reverse(tnl.begin(), tnl.end());

        for (int i = 1; i <= h; ++i) {
            if (nl[i] == tnl[i]) {
                ans += sl[i-1] + h - i + 1;
                h = i - 1;
                cn = tnl[i-1];
                if (cn == tnl[i] * 2) {
                    cn = tnl[i] * 2 + 1;
                    cp = false;
                } else {
                    cn = tnl[i] * 2;
                    cp = true;
                }
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
